title: S3 Ransomware via SSE-C Encryption
description: Detects S3 object writes that use customer-provided encryption keys (SSE-C), a technique used to encrypt a victim's objects with attacker-held keys and hold them for ransom (Data Encrypted for Impact). Aligned to MITRE ATT&CK T1486 analytic AN0606 (PutObject/UploadPart with SSE-C). REQUIRES S3 DATA-EVENT LOGGING: PutObject/CopyObject/UploadPart are S3 data-plane events and are NOT recorded by default CloudTrail management-event logging (the standard SOF-ELK ingest). Enable CloudTrail S3 data events on the relevant buckets for this rule to fire.
falsePositives: Legitimate applications that use SSE-C with client-managed encryption keys.
